fields.label: Preset Chosen
fields.description: A RECORD of what the user picked, for display only. Nothing reads this to decide risk — the resolved parameters below are the truth. Redefining a preset later must not re-risk anybody already running.

fields.label: Resolved On
fields.description: When the preset was resolved into the parameters below. With the preset name, this is enough to explain any later divergence from the current preset table.

fields.label: Risk Per Trade (% of equity)
fields.description: Maximum equity fraction a single position may risk between entry and stop. Percentages here are of EQUITY, not balance — a drawdown guard that ignores open losses is not a guard.

fields.label: Daily Loss Limit (% of equity)
fields.description: Realised-plus-unrealised loss within one trading day that stops new entries for the rest of it.

fields.label: Max Drawdown (% from peak equity)
fields.description: Fall from peak equity that flattens and halts the bot. Restarting is a user action.

fields.label: Account Currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the broker account these limits were set against. The four limits above are percentages and so are currency-free, but the moment any absolute cap is added it must sit next to a code — a stored amount whose currency was never recorded cannot be recovered later. Kept here so that day-one field is already present rather than retrofitted.
